================================================================
Ceremonial Magic and Sorcery
Manly P. Hall · 1928 · folio p.306 · ECHO CRAFT.SYM

THESIS
  Magic is a misused temple rite; the grimoire is a wrecked liturgy.

POINTS
  * Black magic of Egypt
  * Faust
  * Mephistopheles of the grimoires
  * Invocation and pacts
  * Pentagram

SEE ALSO  elements  cryptogram  pharmacology  rose-cross
DEGREE    NEOPHYTE may read this screen
================================================================
translation: Hall is not writing a how-to. He treats ceremonial magic as what happens when the mystery's tools are taken off the temple floor and used for private appetite. Faust is the type. The grimoires are leftover liturgies with the names of spirits where the gods were. The pentagram is the human measure (five points, five wounds, five senses) which can face either way. The chapter belongs next to the elements and the pharmacy: same cabinet, darker drawer.
